dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, thin, high-contrast white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts against dark grey flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Moderate prominence; pale grey-white edges on folded flight feathers provide linear contrast against darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Large, high-contrast white patch with a semi-oval footprint on the lateral neck and posterior nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear boundary between the black crown/nape and the yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright yellowish wash on the upper mantle at the junction with the black nape.
